title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Trump's 43rd Title Controversy
items.text: Donald Trump claimed leads in both Senior and Super Senior divisions at his 43rd club championship with a 70 at Trump National Bedminster, sparking renewed cheating accusations due to the tournament being held at his own course.

items.headline: Schauffele Joins $100M Club
items.text: Xander Schauffele moved to No. 9 on the PGA Tour career money list, joining Tiger Woods, Rory McIlroy, and Scottie Scheffler as the only players with over $100 million in earnings.
